description.value: Background checks and Hogan psychometric assessments
description.quote: CONDUCT BACKGROUND CHECKS, STATUTORY DISQUALIFICATION VERIFICATION AND HOGAN EXECUTIVE

submission.quote: Bidders must submit responses via e-mail at: quotations@portsregulator.org

evaluation.quote: Price will be composed of 80%, and specific goals will be composed of 20%.
evaluation.note: No literal '80/20' in the RFQ; the SBD 6.1 form lists both systems.

validity_days.quote: remain open for acceptance by the Ports Regulator for a period of 90 days

contact.quote: All enquiries relating to this RFQ should be sent via email: quotations@portsregulator.org

pricing_format.value: Unit rates per service in the pricing schedule, inclusive of VAT
pricing_format.quote: Bidders' price quotations must be inclusive of all applicable taxes (including VAT).

returnables.name: SBD 6.1 preference points claim form
returnables.quote: The SBD forms must be completed, signed by the authorised company representative.

returnables.name: Proof of PBSA or SABSA registration
returnables.quote: The bidder must be registered with the Professional Background Screening Association (PBSA)

returnables.name: Three signed client reference letters (2 screening, 1 psychometric, not older than 5 years)
returnables.quote: three (3) signed and dated client reference letters, on client letterhead, not older than five (5) years

returnables.name: Proof of CSD registration (CSD report)
returnables.quote: The bidder must submit proof of registration on CSD (Central Supplier Database).

returnables.name: B-BBEE certificate or sworn affidavit (for specific-goal points)
returnables.quote: Valid B-BBEE certificate or sworn affidavit
returnables.note: Needed to claim the 20 points, so mandatory can be either.

returnables.name: Quotation on company letterhead with the priced schedule (unit rates, VAT incl.)
Supplier POPIA consent form
returnables.quote: SUPPLIER CONSENT: PROTECTION OF PERSONAL INFORMATION ACT

returnables.name: RFQ cover page with supplier details, signed

disqualifiers.name: Late or incomplete submission
disqualifiers.quote: Late and incomplete submissions will invalidate the quote submitted.

disqualifiers.quote: Failure by the bidder to provide the mandatory requirements as indicated above will lead to bidder's proposal not being considered
